find_frequent_element: find the most frequent element in an array using sorting and counting consecutive occurrences
run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the most frequent element in the first n elements of an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays to verify correct frequent element detection
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to find the most frequent element without sorting the input array
summarize_f_gold: summarize how f_gold sorts an array and counts consecutive elements to find the most frequent one
